title: The Night Keeper
logline: My father guarded a mall at night so I could study by day, and one day I will rebuild his house.
style_block: warm hand-painted illustration, soft film grain, muted earth tones with amber lamp light, gentle and dignified mood, subject centred in frame, no text, no letters, no logos

father.description: an Ethiopian man in his fifties with dark brown skin, slim, short greying curly hair, wearing a long worn dark-green wool coat with brass buttons, face mostly turned away or in shadow

child.description: an Ethiopian girl about eight years old with dark brown skin in a clean blue school uniform with braided hair, carrying a small school bag

adult_me.description: an Ethiopian woman, 27 years old, in a plain white blouse, hair tied back, seen in profile

narration.style: warm (via voice choice; the style text is not sent, see EXPERIMENTS E2)

cues.caption: instrumental, slow and tender, solo krar and soft strings, sparse, warm, night-time, Ethiopian pentatonic, no drums
cues.intent: Quiet weight of the night shift; leave room for the voice

cues.caption: instrumental, hopeful, the same krar theme returning with gentle piano and warm strings, building softly, no drums
cues.intent: Lift into the promise; the theme returns so the ending feels like home

shots.reason: Establishes place and time: the city sleeps, he doesn't
shots.image_prompt: a quiet African city at night seen from above, one large shopping mall glowing softly in the centre, empty streets, a few distant lights
shots.motion_prompt: the camera pushes in very slowly toward the mall, lights flicker gently
shots.narration: Every night, while the city slept, my father kept watch over a mall that was not his.

shots.reason: Introduces him without showing a real face; he looks small next to the building
shots.image_prompt: the father seen from behind, sitting on a plastic chair beside the large closed glass doors of a mall at night, a single lamp above him
shots.motion_prompt: fixed camera, his shoulders rise with a slow breath, the lamp light flickers softly
shots.narration: He sat by the doors in his old coat, through the long night shift.

shots.reason: The coat motif, and a breath of music after the opening. Hands only: his face stays hidden (ETHICS.md)
shots.image_prompt: close-up of a tired dark-brown-skinned hand resting on the knee of a long worn dark-green wool overcoat with a brass button on the sleeve, no face in the frame, lamp light
shots.motion_prompt: fixed camera, the fingers move slightly, dust drifts in the lamp light

shots.reason: Morning after a full night; tiredness
shots.image_prompt: the father walking home alone along a dusty road at sunrise, the city behind him, long shadows, golden light
shots.motion_prompt: the camera pans slowly to follow him, he walks slowly away
shots.narration: In the morning he came home tired, and still he made sure I went to school.

shots.reason: The trade-off made visible: his night buys my day
shots.image_prompt: seen from behind, both with their backs to the camera and faces not visible: the father and a small girl with dark brown skin walking hand in hand toward an open school gate in the morning
shots.motion_prompt: fixed camera, they walk slowly toward the gate

shots.image_prompt: the girl, a dark-brown-skinned Ethiopian child with deep brown skin, sitting at a wooden desk in a simple classroom, writing carefully in an exercise book, soft warm side light
shots.motion_prompt: the camera pushes in gently, her hand writes slowly
shots.narration: A school he could not afford, until he decided he could.

shots.reason: "He never told me what it cost him": the coat at rest
shots.image_prompt: a long knee-length worn dark-green wool overcoat with brass buttons hanging on a nail on the mud wall of a small home, the whole coat visible down to its hem, warm lamp light
shots.motion_prompt: fixed camera, the lamp light flickers softly on the coat
shots.narration: He never told me what it cost him.

shots.image_prompt: the young woman sitting at an office desk with a laptop at dusk, looking out of a tall window at the city
shots.motion_prompt: the camera pushes in slowly, she turns her head toward the window
shots.narration: Today I work for a good company. I can help him now. But I am not where I want to be. Not yet.

shots.reason: Grounds the promise in a real place
shots.image_prompt: a small old mud house with a rusty tin roof and a wooden door, at the edge of a town, late afternoon light
shots.motion_prompt: fixed camera, light wind moves the grass, a thin cloud passes
shots.narration: Because one day, I will rebuild his house.

shots.reason: The promise; the coat motif comes home
shots.image_prompt: the same plot rebuilt as a modest new house with clean walls and a new roof, a worn dark-green wool coat hanging by the new door, warm golden dream-like light
shots.motion_prompt: the camera pushes in slowly toward the door, warm light glows
